raw_text: ALERT: A video purportedly showing a Supreme Court judge announcing a verdict on a religious land dispute is circulating on social media. We can confirm NO such hearing was listed on today's cause list. The Supreme Court has not issued any such order. The video appears to be manipulated. We are seeking an official statement from the Court's registry.
clean_text: Bar and Bench confirms no such hearing was listed on Supreme Court cause list. Video appears manipulated. Seeking official statement from Court registry.
